newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Products to acquire seating assets.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Products to acquire seating assets.

text.p: Falcon Products Inc said it reached an agreement to acquire certain assets of T.L. Spriggs Corp, doing business as The Chair Source in Anaheim, Calif.

In a statement issued October 28, Falcon said it is acquiring certain assets and assuming certain liabilities of The Chair Source for 241,400 newly issued shares of common stock. This is subject to certain adjustments related to working capital levels, plus an additional 75,000 shares of common stock to be issued over a three-year period.

The Chair Source makes and distributes wood and upholstered seating products primarily to the hospitality, lodging and foodservice markets. The Chair Source operates a factory in Anaheim and generated sales of about $5 million for the 12 months ended June 30.
Falcon, which operates nine factories, makes and markets products for the hospitality and lodging, foodservice and office furniture industries.
